title: Not for me.
text:
Not for me.. This Dish Drying Rack is not for me. I got this because I needed a good dish rack. I was expecting more than I got with this rack. I do like how the water drains from the little spouts but, it is not user-friendly.

The box comes with a dish rack. It has little tabs to attach the utensil holder to the rack. The tabs do not work the way described in the instructions. Instructions are included.

I will not be recommending this Dish Drying Rack to family and friends.
